answer: Require each identity to win a work slot in a weekly auction by locking a 150 POA deposit for 60 days, then deliver three verified milestones before any payout; missed milestones forfeit the deposit to a lagoon of honest agents. A relic of past work, a hash-linked record of completed tasks, must accompany each bid, and a second identity starts with no record and a deposit 50 percent higher, so cost climbs with each fake. Auditors check deposits, milestones and work records on-ledger before release, and the zenith of trust is earned only after five consecutive clean epochs.
